overview: We bring your Shopify theme up to date and fix the layout problems that come with age. First we duplicate your live theme, so nothing is risked. We update the theme version, carry across your customizations, then check the home, collection, product, cart and checkout pages on phone and desktop. Spacing, broken sections and odd image crops are fixed, and you get a before and after list.

faq: Will I lose my theme edits when you update?
No. We copy the live theme first, update on the copy, and move your custom sections, code and settings across. You only publish the new theme when you are happy with the preview link we send.
Can you update a theme I bought from a theme store?
Yes, if you have a licence. Many paid themes need the licence holder to download the new version, and if that is needed we guide you through it in a few minutes.
No. This service keeps your current look and removes problems. A new design, new sections or a bespoke build is quoted as a separate project, because it takes more time than this sprint allows.
What if my theme is very old?

Some old themes cannot be updated in place. If that applies, we tell you after the review and move your content to the current version of the same theme, or suggest the nearest match, and quote any extra.
